description: Use official MicroG-RE 7.2.1 for Google Maps and synthesized navigation speech, start Google TTS before guidance and skip the uncertified-device screen. Includes an opt-in native EV model experiment that sends BYD battery data and estimated road-load coefficients to Google. Arrival forecasts and navigation display remain experimental. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer.

patches.name: BYD native battery experiment
patches.description: Experimental: sends this BYD's battery and road-load model to Google through Maps' native EV route requests. Starts from the car's own average consumption, learns slowly from BMS energy/distance, and adds in-app vehicle settings. Native hooks inspected on Maps 26.41. Targets BYD DiLink 3; DiLink 5 unverified.

options.description: Experimental: shows an inline battery icon and Google's arrival percentage after ETA.

patches.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.1, skips the uncertified-device screen, and prefers synthesized navigation speech with early Google TTS startup and the existing audio fallback.

release_notes:
- Google Maps for MicroG-RE: Maps now starts Google TTS as soon as it opens, instead of waiting for navigation to start, so the first voice prompts are synthesized rather than falling back to generic audio (#10).
- Google Maps for MicroG-RE: Maps no longer closes on the "This device isn't Play Protect certified" screen (#11).

Tested on a BYD Dolphin, DiLink 3.0 with Maps `26.41.04.993332563`, MicroG-RE 7.2.1 and patched Google TTS. A cold start with Thai voice guidance read street names from the first prompt.

Limitations: the Play Protect fix was not tested on a phone, because the test car never shows that screen. Other BYD models and DiLink 5.0 are untested.
